lore: A master of ancient elemental magic, The Grand Invoker once commanded the very forces of creation. Banished from his home for wielding power deemed too dangerous, he now wanders the Spire, seeking forgotten knowledge to reclaim his lost dominion. His presence twists the very fabric of reality, weaving raw elements into devastating spells.
theme: Arcane Elemental Mastery, Forbidden Knowledge, Aristocratic Power

appearance.body: Tall, slender, and elegantly built, conveying an air of aristocratic grace and potent, contained power. Lean physique beneath voluminous robes.
appearance.clothing: Opulent, dark robes of deep indigo and rich purple, trimmed with intricate golden embroidery and flowing white/silver silk accents. High collar, broad shoulders, and long, sweeping sleeves. The fabric appears heavy and luxurious, with deep folds catching dramatic light.
appearance.accessories: Three distinct elemental orbs (one fiery red-orange, one icy blue-white, one crackling electric yellow-cyan) perpetually orbit him, glowing intensely. Golden pauldrons or shoulder accents integrated into the robes. A subtle, ornate arcane focus or staff may be held.
appearance.face: Sharp, angular features with a high nose and prominent cheekbones, conveying an intelligent and aloof expression. Intense, glowing eyes (perhaps a subtle arcane glow in the pupils). Long, straight, flowing white/silver hair cascades past his shoulders, styled with a regal sweep. A faint, knowing smirk.
appearance.silhouette: Distinctive, tall and elegant. The flowing robes create a wide, dramatic base, tapering upwards to broad, ornate shoulders. The orbiting elemental orbs create a dynamic, ethereal aura around his upper body, making his silhouette instantly recognizable and powerful. Strong, clean lines with sharp angles.

colorPalette.primary: Deep royal purples, rich midnight blues, and dark teals for robes. Earthy golds and dark browns for accents and embroidery.
colorPalette.secondary: Vibrant fiery reds and oranges for fire orb/effects, electric blues and cyans for ice/lightning orb/effects, bright yellows for lightning/general arcane energy.
colorPalette.accent: Intense flashes of pure white, bright yellow, and glowing cyan for spell impact and orb energy core.
colorPalette.glow: Luminous yellows, fiery oranges, and electric cyans/blues for elemental orbs, spell effects, and subtle arcane energy radiating from the Invoker himself.

artStyle.viewAngle: 3/4 front-facing view, slightly low angle, emphasizing height and power.
artStyle.lighting: Dramatic and high-contrast, with a strong, single directional light source from above-left, creating deep, sharp shadows under folds of clothing and facial features. Elemental orbs exhibit strong self-illumination, casting localized colored light onto his robes and face. Intense glowing highlights on metallic accents and energy effects.
artStyle.renderStyle: painterly, STS2 style, 2D illustration, dark fantasy

animations.name: idle
animations.description: The Invoker stands tall and regal, robes gently swaying as if by an unseen breeze. His three elemental orbs slowly orbit him in a mesmerizing, controlled dance, each pulsing with subtle energy. His head is held high, eyes scanning with a contained power. Subtle shifts in weight or hand gestures, maintaining a commanding presence.

animations.name: attack
animations.description: The Invoker raises a hand dramatically, channeling raw elemental power. The three orbiting orbs rapidly converge and then burst outwards in a focused beam or projectile of combined elemental energy (e.g., a fiery meteor, an icy shard storm, or a lightning blast). His robes billow violently, hair whips around, and his face contorts with intense focus and power. Strong glowing effects emanate from his hand and the launched spell. After the release, he returns to a slightly more poised, ready stance.

His body jerks back, robes momentarily flaring, and the elemental orbs briefly flicker or wobble out of their perfect orbit before quickly snapping back into place. A subtle, bright impact flash appears where the hit connects, quickly fading.

animations.name: death
animations.description: The Invoker stumbles forward, his form wavering. The elemental orbs lose their cohesion, flaring brightly one last time before dissipating into wisps of colored smoke. He collapses dramatically to one knee, then falls prone, his body fading slightly as if his arcane essence is departing. Robes settle around him, losing their vibrant color, becoming muted and dark.
